summary: Iteration 7 visual regression sweep at viewport 1920x800 across 13 routes. PASSED: (a) Round circular FoeGuard logo (PNG, border-radius 50%, 2px khaki ring rgb(216,207,184) = #D8CFB8) replaces the previous SVG wordmark in ModernNavbar across /, /menu, /about, /faq, /delivery (and all other tested routes). (b) Khaki visibility: nav border-bottom is 3px solid #D8CFB8 AND the round logo has a 2px khaki ring. (c) Hero tri-image on / now has NO outer border and NO box-shadow (computed border:'0px none', box-shadow:'none'); rounded-corner container preserved (borderRadius 20px on grandparent). (d) Brand red #c8102e (rgb(200,16,46)) verified on: Shop Now button on /, About-page hero background, 'Get in Touch' heading on /contact, Send Message button on /contact, Add button on /menu/comfort-dinner, slide-cart Checkout button, '+ Add more items' link, cart-badge circle on navbar, selected size-pill red underline. (e) Cart flow regression: Add → slide cart opens (Subtotal $26.99 line, red Checkout button) → /checkout loads with ModernNavbar visible. (f) Headings fully visible below the 122px navbar on /about (Why FoeGuard?), /new-to-raw, /contact, /calculator, /policies, /terms, /account, /blog, /faq, /delivery — h1 top ≥ 168. Additionally MealPlanPage.js stepper badge '1' still renders in OLD burgundy/brown #8B4513 (regression — request explicitly listed MealPlanPage.js as needing colors swapped).

critical_code_review_comments: Color tokens are well centralized in App.css (--barn-red, --khaki, --charcoal). Pages should consume these CSS variables instead of repeating raw hex inline styles — current inline #8B4513 usage made this iteration partially miss its target. Suggest a follow-up refactor to swap inline hex to var(--barn-red).

LandingPage.js still hosts ModernNavbar and ModernFooter (re-exported via Layout.js). The 108px top-spacer is owned by LandingPage, so each route depends on this re-export — MealPlanPage likely renders a layout that bypasses the spacer (e.g., its own wrapper has negative/zero top padding). Extracting ModernNavbar/ModernFooter into /components/* and shipping the spacer with the nav itself would prevent this kind of regression.
